scientist_dialogue.speaker: Dr. Aris
scientist_dialogue.text: Thank God someone is alive! The automated security defense grid went haywire after the core failure.

choices.text: How do I get out of this facility?
Do you have the security card for the main exit?
Stay hidden. I'll deal with the robots.

scientist_dialogue.speaker: Dr. Aris
scientist_dialogue.text: A power surge corrupted the sub-level routing. The security robots now classify all biological personnel as unauthorized contaminants.

choices.text: I see. Let's talk about our options.

scientist_dialogue.speaker: Dr. Aris
scientist_dialogue.text: The main blast doors to the surface are just south of here, but they require high-clearance access. Without the Master Access Card, the door remains hermetically sealed.

choices.text: I need to check my gear first.

scientist_dialogue.speaker: Dr. Aris
scientist_dialogue.text: Here, take my Master Access Card. Slide it into the blast door terminal to the south. Go to the surface and alert the outside world!

choices.text: Thank you, Doctor. I'm getting us out of here.
